metadata.scope: Source-code audit of data flows, storage, network requests, and logging. No live deployment verification.
metadata.disclaimer: This inventory reflects source code as of the audit date. Live deployment configuration (nginx, environment variables, DNS, CDN) may differ. No claim of completeness beyond the files read.

browser_storage.cookies: None found (no document.cookie calls in source)

keys.notes: Default is light. Stored as plain string.

keys.contents: Cached JSON: /api/market payload, CoinGecko 90-day charts, tickers, health
keys.notes: Market data cache. SWR pattern. No user data.

keys.contents: One-time migration from legacy keys, then deleted
keys.notes: Migration code runs once, prunes old keys.

frontend.notes: Only third-party tracker-adjacent call in the dashboard. Not present in research hub. No opt-out/consent surface exists.
Only for 90-day chart and tickers on individual coin pages. Market data is not personal data.

frontend.trigger: Dashboard data loading, AI narrative fetch
frontend.data_disclosed: Same-origin request; backend sees visitor IP in server logs

backend.type: Server-side REST API with Bearer token
backend.data_disclosed: Server IP, Authorization: Bearer HELIX_API_KEY, User-Agent stablesense-cron/1.0
backend.notes: HELIX_API_KEY is a server-side secret. No user data sent.

backend.data_disclosed: Server IP, Authorization: Bearer OPENAI_API_KEY, x-opencode-session header
backend.notes: Sends aggregated market/stress/alert context only. No user PII. OPENAI_BASE_URL may point to a non-OpenAI provider (e.g., OpenRouter) depending on environment configuration.

backend_endpoints.transport: Origin: HTTP (no TLS in nginx config; listen 80 only). Public: HTTPS terminated at Cloudflare edge (verified 2026-10-02, response header server: cloudflare).

database.user_data_tables: None - no user, account, or identity tables

fastify_request_logger.captures: remoteAddress (caller IP), remotePort, request method, URL, response time, status code
fastify_request_logger.notes: Default Fastify logger. Currently only reachable via nginx on localhost, but nginx forwards X-Forwarded-For.

nginx_access_log.config: Sets X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto headers; no explicit access_log directive, so nginx default applies
nginx_access_log.captures: Client IP, request line, status, bytes sent, referer, user-agent
nginx_access_log.notes: Default nginx access log format includes client IP. Log rotation/retention not configured in repo.

cron_logs.notes: No request data in cron logs.

logging.database_persisted_ip: No - IP addresses are not written to any database table

third_party_providers.name: Cloudflare
third_party_providers.data_shared: IP address, User-Agent, request metadata, network error reports (NEL)
third_party_providers.location: Cloudflare global edge (verified server: cloudflare, cf-ray ...-AMS)
third_party_providers.notes: Edge in front of the whole site; sees every visitor request before the origin. Added 2026-10-02 after a live header check confirmed the site is proxied through Cloudflare.

third_party_providers.name: Google Fonts
third_party_providers.notes: Only third-party browser-direct call. Self-hosting would eliminate it.

third_party_providers.name: CoinGecko
third_party_providers.data_shared: Visitor IP (browser-direct for charts/tickers); Server IP (backend for history)
third_party_providers.notes: No API key required for public endpoints.

third_party_providers.name: OpenAI (or compatible provider)
third_party_providers.data_shared: Server IP, API key, aggregated market context
third_party_providers.notes: Backend-only. Sends aggregated market/stress/alert data, no user PII. Provider may vary by deployment.

personal_data_summary.collected_from_users: IP address and request metadata (via the Cloudflare edge, server access logs, and browser-direct API calls)
personal_data_summary.stored_in_browser: UI preferences only (theme, refresh interval, compact mode, tour dismissal)
personal_data_summary.forms: None - no input forms in the application
personal_data_summary.analytics: None - no gtag, Segment, Sentry, or tracking scripts
personal_data_summary.conclusion: The application collects no directly identifying personal data (no names, emails, phone numbers, wallet addresses, or account credentials). The personal data that does exist is IP addresses and request metadata seen by the Cloudflare edge, written to server access logs, and sent in browser-direct API calls. These are network identifiers.

discrepancies.detail: docs/data-sources.md:3,16-24 and docs/api-protocol.md:14-24 describe dashboard fetching DefiLlama/CoinGecko browser-direct. Current code uses /api/market (backend to Helix) for supply/price. Only coin-tab 90-day chart/tickers are still browser-direct CoinGecko.
discrepancies.impact: Privacy policy must reflect actual data paths, not stale docs.
AGENTS.md requires these stay in sync. Not a privacy issue but indicates drift.

discrepancies.detail: Repo contains backend/data/stablepulse.db* but db.js:121 opens stablesense.db
discrepancies.impact: Legacy artifact only, not a privacy issue.

discrepancies.detail: backend/deploy/nginx.conf listens on port 80 only, no TLS/certbot configuration. Public traffic reaches Cloudflare over HTTPS; the origin-to-edge hop is not shown as encrypted in the repo config.
discrepancies.impact: Public visitors do get HTTPS via the Cloudflare edge. The unverified part is origin encryption and whether the backend is ever exposed directly. Low risk while the backend stays bound to localhost.

discrepancies.detail: Backend endpoints have no rate limiting in code
discrepancies.impact: Abuse potential, not directly a privacy issue.
